long_biography.plain_text:
Nikola Alexandrov studied business administration at the University of Portsmouth. In 2008, he co-founded a service that compared offers from online travel agencies by matching their hotel databases. A funding round coincided with the financial crisis, and the venture was discontinued.

When considering outside capital, Alexandrov looked for contributions beyond money. LockTrip agreed an investment with Australia’s Webjet in 2021, following discussions about blockchain and hotel distribution. The arrangement brought two Webjet executives onto its board. For Alexandrov, the attraction included access to the travel group’s existing online booking businesses.
long_biography.html:
Nikola Alexandrov studied business administration at the University of Portsmouth. In 2008, he co-founded a service that compared offers from online travel agencies by matching their hotel databases. A funding round coincided with the financial crisis, and the venture was discontinued.

When considering outside capital, Alexandrov looked for contributions beyond money. LockTrip agreed an investment with Australia’s Webjet in 2021, following discussions about blockchain and hotel distribution. The arrangement brought two Webjet executives onto its board. For Alexandrov, the attraction included access to the travel group’s existing online booking businesses.
